title: Madame Roulin and Her Baby
description: Madame Roulin and Her Baby, masterwork by Vincent van Gogh (Dutch, Zundert 1853–1890 Auvers-sur-Oise). Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Painted during Van Gogh's pivotal French period between Arles and Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. Facing profound isolation and mental turmoil, Van Gogh turned to intense chromatic vibrancy and rapid gestural mark-making, seeking spiritual solace in rural life, humble objects, and swirling nocturnal skies.
historical_context_id: Dilukis selama periode penting Van Gogh di Prancis antara Arles dan Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. Menghadapi isolasi mendalam dan pergolakan batin, Van Gogh beralih ke intensitas warna cerah dan goresan kuas cepat penuh ekspresi, mencari ketenangan spiritual dalam kehidupan pedesaan dan langit malam.
artistic_analysis_en: Mastery of heavy impasto application directly from the tube. Van Gogh used complementary color contrasts (cobalt blues against chrome yellows) with rhythmic, calligraphic brushstrokes that infuse the surface with palpable kinetic energy.
artistic_analysis_id: Penguasaan teknik impasto tebal yang diaplikasikan langsung ke kanvas. Van Gogh memanfaatkan kontras warna komplementer (biru kobalt versus kuning krom) dengan goresan ritmis kaligrafis yang memancarkan energi kinetik.
provenance_en: Theo van Gogh collection, Paris; Jo van Gogh-Bonger, Amsterdam; acquired through bequest and donation to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Koleksi Theo van Gogh, Paris; Jo van Gogh-Bonger, Amsterdam; dihibahkan dan didonasikan kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: I dream of painting and then I paint my dream.
curator_quote_id: Saya bermimpi tentang melukis, dan kemudian saya melukis mimpi saya.

title: Portrait of Gerard de Lairesse
description: Portrait of Gerard de Lairesse, masterwork by Rembrandt (Rembrandt van Rijn) (Dutch, Leiden 1606–1669 Amsterdam). Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Created during the zenith of the Dutch Golden Age in 17th-century Amsterdam. Rembrandt revolutionized portraiture by stripping away idealized facades, probing deep psychological interiority, mortality, and the complex dignity of everyday human emotion.
historical_context_id: Diciptakan pada puncak Zaman Keemasan Belanda abad ke-17 di Amsterdam. Rembrandt merevolusi seni potret dengan menanggalkan kepura-puraan idealistik, menggali kejiwaan manusia yang mendalam, kefanaan, dan martabat emosi manusia.
artistic_analysis_en: Legendary mastery of tenebrism and dramatic chiaroscuro. Rembrandt layered translucent oil glazes over rough, textured underpaintings, allowing light to emerge organically from deep shadows.
artistic_analysis_id: Penguasaan legendaris atas teknik tenebrisme dan chiaroscuro dramatis. Rembrandt melapisi glasir minyak transparan di atas cat dasar bertekstur, membiarkan cahaya memancar organik dari kegelapan pekat.
provenance_en: Aristocratic European collections; purchased by J. Pierpont Morgan; gifted to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Koleksi bangsawan Eropa; dibeli oleh J. Pierpont Morgan; dihibahkan kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: Without atmosphere a painting is nothing.
curator_quote_id: Tanpa atmosfer dan jiwa, sebuah lukisan bukanlah apa-apa.

description: Young Woman with a Water Pitcher, masterwork by Johannes Vermeer (Dutch, Delft 1632–1675 Delft). Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Painted in the quiet, reflective town of Delft during the mid-1600s. Vermeer produced fewer than 40 documented works in his lifetime, focusing on serene domestic interiors that capture quiet moments of meditation and moral contemplation.
historical_context_id: Dilukis di kota tenang Delft pada pertengahan abad ke-17. Vermeer hanya menghasilkan kurang dari 40 lukisan sepanjang hidupnya, berfokus pada interior domestik hening yang menangkap momen meditatif dan kontemplasi moral.
artistic_analysis_en: Pioneering use of the camera obscura perspective and optical pointillé. Vermeer ground costly natural lapis lazuli into his pigments, bathing simple domestic settings in crystalline, photorealistic daylight.
artistic_analysis_id: Pelopor penggunaan perspektif camera obscura dan teknik optik pointillé. Vermeer mencampurkan pigmen lapis lazuli alami yang mahal, memandikan ruang domestik sederhana dalam cahaya alami yang jernih dan fotorealistis.
provenance_en: Delft municipal collections; Marquand Collection; presented to The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York.
provenance_id: Koleksi kota Delft; Koleksi Marquand; diserahkan secara resmi kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York.
curator_quote_en: Light transforms the ordinary into sacred silence.
curator_quote_id: Cahaya mengubah hal-hal biasa menjadi keheningan yang agung.

title: Leisure Time in an Elegant Setting
description: Leisure Time in an Elegant Setting, masterwork by Pieter de Hooch (Dutch, Rotterdam 1629–1684 Amsterdam). Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Preserved in the permanent archives of The Metropolitan Museum of Art. This artwork exemplifies the stylistic developments, workshop traditions, and cultural ethos of its historical era.
historical_context_id: Terpelihara dalam arsip permanen The Metropolitan Museum of Art. Karya ini mencontohkan perkembangan gaya, tradisi studio seni, dan etos budaya pada era sejarahnya.
artistic_analysis_en: Classical academic layering with hand-ground mineral pigments, linseed oil emulsion, and varnish glazing.
artistic_analysis_id: Pelapisan akademis klasik dengan pigmen mineral alami, emulsi minyak biji rami, dan glasir pernis.
provenance_en: European private collections; gift of museum patrons to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Koleksi pribadi Eropa; hibah dari patron seni kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: Every painting is a voyage into a sacred harbour.
curator_quote_id: Setiap lukisan adalah perjalanan menuju dermaga yang agung.

title: The Rehearsal of the Ballet Onstage
medium: Oil colors freely mixed with turpentine, with traces of watercolor and pastel over pen-and-ink drawing on cream-colored wove paper, laid down on bristol board and mounted on canvas
description: The Rehearsal of the Ballet Onstage, masterwork by Edgar Degas (French, Paris 1834–1917 Paris). Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Produced during the height of late 19th-century Parisian Impressionism. Degas was fascinated by modern leisure, the movement of racehorses, and the rigorous behind-the-scenes discipline of Paris Opera ballet dancers.
historical_context_id: Dihasilkan pada puncak gerakan Impresionisme Paris akhir abad ke-19. Degas terpikat oleh dinamika modernitas perkotaan, pacuan kuda, dan kedisiplinan ketat para penari balet Opera Paris.
artistic_analysis_en: Daring asymmetrical cropping influenced by Japanese Ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Degas combined pastel, gouache, and oil with dynamic spatial diagonals to freeze fleeting physical motion.
artistic_analysis_id: Pemotongan sudut pandang asimetris yang dipengaruhi cetakan balok kayu Ukiyo-e Jepang. Degas memadukan pastel, gouache, dan cat minyak dengan garis diagonal dinamis untuk membekukan gerakan fisik yang sekilas.
provenance_en: Havemeyer Collection; bequest of Mrs. H. O. Havemeyer to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Koleksi Havemeyer; warisan dari Ny. H. O. Havemeyer kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see.
curator_quote_id: Seni bukanlah apa yang Anda lihat, melainkan apa yang Anda buat orang lain lihat.

title: Street, Dresden
description: Street, Dresden, a seminal Expressionist masterwork by Ernst Ludwig Kirchner. Preserved in the Modern and Contemporary Art collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Painted in 1908 as a foundational work of the German Die Brücke (The Bridge) expressionist movement. Kirchner captured the psychological alienation, frantic speed, and claustrophobic energy of urban modern life in early 20th-century Dresden.
historical_context_id: Dilukis pada tahun 1908 sebagai karya penting gerakan ekspresionisme Die Brücke di Jerman. Kirchner menangkap keterasingan psikologis, kecepatan hidup yang hiruk-pikuk, dan energi kota modern Dresden awal abad ke-20.
artistic_analysis_en: Kirchner used jarring complementary colors—acidic yellows, intense oranges, and cobalt blues—paired with jagged, diagonal perspectives to evoke the psychological friction of modern crowds.
artistic_analysis_id: Kirchner menggunakan kontras warna tajam yang saling bertabrakan—kuning asam, oranye menyala, dan biru kobalt—dipadukan dengan perspektif diagonal bersudut tajam untuk memunculkan gesekan psikologis kerumunan kota.
provenance_en: Collection of the artist; private collections in Germany and New York; purchase, Lila Acheson Wallace Gift, The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Koleksi seniman; koleksi pribadi di Jerman dan New York; dibeli melalui Hibah Lila Acheson Wallace, The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: Color is the direct voice of the painter's psychological conviction.
curator_quote_id: Warna adalah suara langsung dari keyakinan psikologis sang pelukis.

title: Houses at L'Estaque
description: Houses at L'Estaque by Georges Braque, one of the historic launching works of Cubism. Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Painted in the south of France following Cézanne's retrospective in Paris. When art critic Louis Vauxcelles saw this landscape, he famously remarked that it reduced nature to 'little cubes', coining the term Cubism.
historical_context_id: Dilukis di selatan Prancis setelah pameran retrospektif Cézanne di Paris. Saat kritikus seni Louis Vauxcelles melihat lukisan lanskap ini, ia menyebut alam telah direduksi menjadi 'kubus-kubus kecil', yang kemudian melahirkan istilah Kubisme.
artistic_analysis_en: Braque abandoned single-point linear perspective, rendering Mediterranean village houses into faceted, interlocking geometric planes in subdued ochres and olive greens.
artistic_analysis_id: Braque meninggalkan perspektif linier konvensional, mengubah rumah-rumah desa Mediterania menjadi bidang-bidang geometris yang saling mengunci dalam palet oker dan hijau zaitun.
provenance_en: Galerie Kahnweiler, Paris; Wilhelm Uhde collection; acquired by The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York.
provenance_id: Galerie Kahnweiler, Paris; koleksi Wilhelm Uhde; diakuisisi oleh The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York.
curator_quote_en: We wanted to create a new, tactile reality on the canvas.
curator_quote_id: Kami ingin menciptakan realitas baru yang nyata dan dapat diraba pada permukaan kanvas.

title: Composition with Red, Yellow, and Blue
description: Composition with Red, Yellow, and Blue, an iconic De Stijl Neoplastic masterpiece by Piet Mondrian. Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Created in Paris during the interwar years as the culmination of the De Stijl movement. Mondrian sought universal spiritual harmony through pure abstraction and irreducible geometric equilibrium.
historical_context_id: Diciptakan di Paris pada masa antar-perang dunia sebagai puncak gerakan De Stijl. Mondrian mencari keharmonisan spiritual universal melalui abstraksi murni dan keseimbangan geometris yang tak terpisahkan.
artistic_analysis_en: Constructed solely with primary colors (cadmium red, ultramarine blue, lemon yellow) and non-colors (white and black grid lines) achieving an asymmetric dynamic balance.
artistic_analysis_id: Dibangun murni hanya dengan warna-warna primer (merah kadmium, biru ultramarin, kuning lemon) dan garis kisi hitam-putih untuk mencapai keseimbangan dinamis yang asimetris.
provenance_en: Artist's studio, Paris; H.M. Kröller-Müller collection; Bequest of Miss Adelaide Milton de Groot to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Studio seniman, Paris; koleksi H.M. Kröller-Müller; Warisan dari Nona Adelaide Milton de Groot kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: Art must be above reality; it must express the universal truth.
curator_quote_id: Seni harus berada di atas realitas fana; seni harus mengekspresikan kebenaran universal.

title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (The Great Wave)
medium: Polychrome woodblock print; ink and color on paper
description: Under the Wave off Kanagawa, internationally renowned as The Great Wave, an iconic Edo-period Ukiyo-e woodblock print by Katsushika Hokusai. Preserved in the Asian Art department of The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Published in the early 1830s as the opening print of Hokusai's legendary series 'Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji'. It captures the sublime power of nature towering over human fishermen in Edo-period Japan.
historical_context_id: Diterbitkan pada awal tahun 1830-an sebagai karya pembuka dari seri legendaris Hokusai 'Tiga Puluh Enam Pemandangan Gunung Fuji'. Menangkap kekuatan alam yang agung menjulang di atas para nelayan pada zaman Edo di Jepang.
artistic_analysis_en: Masterful integration of imported Prussian Blue pigment with traditional Japanese woodblock carving. The dynamic fractal crests of the wave visually frame the distant, serene silhouette of Mount Fuji.
artistic_analysis_id: Integrasi brilian antara pigmen Biru Prusia impor dengan teknik ukiran balok kayu tradisional Jepang. Puncak ombak yang menyerupai cakar membingkai siluet tenang Gunung Fuji di kejauhan.
provenance_en: Edo print collectors, Japan; H.O. Havemeyer Collection; Bequest of Mrs. H. O. Havemeyer to The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1929.
provenance_id: Kolektor cetakan zaman Edo, Jepang; Koleksi H.O. Havemeyer; Warisan Ny. H. O. Havemeyer kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1929.
curator_quote_en: From the age of six I had a passion for copying the form of things.
curator_quote_id: Sejak usia enam tahun, saya telah memiliki gairah tak terpadamkan untuk menggambar bentuk segala sesuatu.

title: Silent Fisherman in an Autumn Wood
medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper
description: Silent Fisherman in an Autumn Wood by Shen Zhou, founder of the Wu School of Ming Dynasty literati painting. Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Created during the Ming Dynasty by the scholar-painter Shen Zhou in Suzhou. It represents the quintessential literati ideal of philosophical seclusion and unity with the seasonal rhythms of the natural cosmos.
historical_context_id: Diciptakan pada masa Dinasti Ming oleh pelukis-cendekiawan Shen Zhou di Suzhou. Mewakili cita-cita kaum terpelajar tentang pengasingan diri yang tenang dan penyatuan batin dengan ritme alam semesta.
artistic_analysis_en: Painted with dry brushwork, layered hemp-fiber texture strokes (pima cun), and subtle mineral washes conveying the tranquility of autumn foliage and mountain mist.
artistic_analysis_id: Dilukis dengan teknik kuas kering, sapuan tekstur serat rami berlapis (pima cun), dan sentuhan pigmen mineral lembut yang menyampaikan ketenangan dedaunan musim gugur dan kabut pegunungan.
provenance_en: Imperial Chinese collections; C.C. Wang Family Collection; Gift of The Dillon Fund to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Koleksi Kekaisaran Tiongkok; Koleksi Keluarga C.C. Wang; Hibah dari The Dillon Fund kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: A single stroke of the brush contains the vastness of heaven and earth.
curator_quote_id: Satu goresan kuas mengandung keluasan langit dan bumi.

title: Flowers of the Four Seasons
medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper
description: Flowers of the Four Seasons handscroll by Shen Zhou, showcasing poetic calligraphy and delicate botanical illustrations. Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Completed in the final months of Shen Zhou's life in 1509. The handscroll unrolls progressively from right to left, leading the viewer on an intimate sensory journey through the blooming flora of the four seasons.
historical_context_id: Diselesaikan pada bulan-bulan terakhir kehidupan Shen Zhou tahun 1509. Gulungan tangan ini dibuka secara bertahap dari kanan ke kiri, mengajak penikmat seni menelusuri mekarnya bunga di empat musim.
artistic_analysis_en: Spontaneous 'boneless' wash technique (mogu) without rigid black outlines, balanced with graceful poetic inscriptions in flowing running-script calligraphy.
artistic_analysis_id: Teknik sapuan tanpa garis tepi hitam kaku (mogu), diseimbangkan secara harmonis dengan inskripsi kaligrafi aksara kursif yang mengalir anggun.
provenance_en: Qing dynasty scholarly collections; Douglas Dillon Collection; Bequest to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Koleksi cendekiawan Dinasti Qing; Koleksi Douglas Dillon; Dihibahkan kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: To paint flowers is to capture the fragrance of passing time.
curator_quote_id: Melukis bunga adalah upaya mengabadikan keharuman waktu yang terus berlalu.

title: Panel with Byzantine Ivory Carving of the Crucifixion
medium: Elephant ivory inset in gilded silver, pearls, and wood backing
description: Panel with Byzantine Ivory Carving of the Crucifixion, an exquisite imperial relic combining Byzantine ivory carving and Romanesque Spanish goldsmithing. Preserved in the Medieval Art department of The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Commissioned for the royal abbey of San Millán de la Cogolla in northern Spain during the Reconquista era. It reflects the intense diplomatic, spiritual, and artistic exchanges between the Byzantine Empire and medieval Western European courts.
historical_context_id: Dibuat untuk biara kerajaan San Millán de la Cogolla di Spanyol utara pada era Reconquista. Mencerminkan pertukaran diplomatik, spiritual, dan artistik yang intens antara Kekaisaran Bizantium dan kerajaan Eropa Barat abad pertengahan.
artistic_analysis_en: High-relief micro-carving executed in precious elephant ivory, framed by repoussé gilded silver work studded with river pearls and cabochon glass gems.
artistic_analysis_id: Ukiran mikro relief tinggi yang dipahat presisi pada gading gajah berharga, dibingkai oleh kerajinan perak berlapis emas bertatahkan mutiara dan permata cabochon.
provenance_en: Treasury of the Monastery of San Millán de la Cogolla; J. Pierpont Morgan Collection; Gift of J. Pierpont Morgan to The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1917.
provenance_id: Perbendaharaan Biara San Millán de la Cogolla; Koleksi J. Pierpont Morgan; Hadiah J. Pierpont Morgan kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1917.
curator_quote_en: The medieval ivory carver transformed raw bone into timeless sacred contemplation.
curator_quote_id: Pemahat abad pertengahan mengubah bahan mentah menjadi sarana kontemplasi spiritual yang abadi.

title: Plaque with the Virgin Mary as Church
description: Carolingian ivory plaque depicting the Virgin Mary as the Personification of the Church, produced in the imperial court workshop of Charlemagne. Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Created during the Carolingian Renaissance under the patronage of Emperor Charlemagne and his successors. The court workshop sought to revive the monumental gravitas and classical drapery of late Roman antiquity.
historical_context_id: Diciptakan pada masa Renaisans Karolingia di bawah naungan Kaisar Charlemagne. Bengkel istana berusaha menghidupkan kembali keagungan proporsi dan lipatan busana klasik zaman Romawi kuno.
artistic_analysis_en: Features fluid classical drapery folds deeply undercut into ivory, demonstrating an astonishing revival of Greco-Roman sculptural anatomical knowledge in early medieval Europe.
artistic_analysis_id: Menampilkan lipatan kain klasik yang dipahat mendalam pada gading, membuktikan kebangkitan pengetahuan anatomi patung Yunani-Romawi di Eropa abad pertengahan awal.
provenance_en: Imperial treasury collections; Prince Soltykoff collection, Paris; Gift of J. Pierpont Morgan to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Perbendaharaan kekaisaran; koleksi Pangeran Soltykoff, Paris; Hadiah J. Pierpont Morgan kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: Charlemagne's artists built a bridge between classical Rome and medieval Europe.
curator_quote_id: Para seniman Charlemagne membangun jembatan antara peradaban Romawi klasik dan Eropa abad pertengahan.

title: Plaque with the Crucifixion and Saints
medium: Painted enamel on copper, partially gilded
description: Painted enamel on copper plaque depicting the Crucifixion with rich polychrome and gold highlights from late medieval Limoges. Preserved in The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
historical_context_en: Produced in the world-renowned artisanal workshops of Limoges, France, at the transition between Late Gothic piety and Northern Renaissance refinement.
historical_context_id: Dihasilkan di bengkel kerajinan enamel terkemuka dunia di Limoges, Prancis, pada masa transisi antara tradisi Gotik Akhir dan kehalusan Renaisans Utara.
artistic_analysis_en: Vitreous enamel pulverized glass fused to hammered copper plates through multiple kiln firings at over 800°C, producing permanent gem-like jewel tones and raised gold foil stars.
artistic_analysis_id: Bubuk kaca enamel dileburkan ke lempengan tembaga melalui pembakaran berulang di atas suhu 800°C, menghasilkan kilau warna permata permanen dan aksen bintang emas timbul.
provenance_en: Château de Chenonceau chapel treasury; Baron Gustave de Rothschild collection; Bequest of George Blumenthal to The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
provenance_id: Perbendaharaan kapel Château de Chenonceau; koleksi Baron Gustave de Rothschild; Warisan George Blumenthal kepada The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
curator_quote_en: Enamel painting captured the eternal fire of late medieval devotion.
curator_quote_id: Lukisan enamel mengabadikan api abadi dari spiritualitas abad pertengahan akhir.
